screens.title: Caravan preparation
screens.description: A hand-painted snow-coast plate frames three unequal road-party tokens and a stitched provisions ledger. Choosing a speaker previews the consequence; a separate confirmation records it.

screens.title: Roadside event
screens.description: A short broken-ferry vignette places two grounded choices beside the current food and fatigue counts. Costs and outcomes appear before the player confirms.

screens.title: Camp trade
screens.description: A low-noise barter ledger shows dried-fish stock, condition, price, and remaining food. One purchase can be explicitly confirmed or cancelled.

expectedText: Maeve will speak for the caravan. Supplies remain at 7 food.

steps.name: Confirm ford: add 1 fatigue to Sigrid

expectedText: The caravan reached the far bank. Sigrid fatigue is now 2. Food remains 7.

steps.name: Confirm trade: spend 2 food for 1 dried fish

expectedText: Trade settled: 1 dried fish added; food 5, stock 2.
